purpose: Every external source this project has identified, with its licence and whether its bytes may be kept in this repository. Sources marked redistributable false are recorded by URL only: run src/fetch_external_data.py to retrieve them locally. Redistributing them here would breach the publisher's terms even though the project is entitled to read and analyse them.

sources.note: The ND clause blocks redistributing a modified form, and mixing NC content into this repository would conflict with its own licence. The survival workbook already in data/raw/external_survival/ came from the Dryad deposit; its licence should be checked separately before release. The full-text XML was used only to read the Methods, which resolved the dose axis in exp11.
